findings.current: —I want to recover even a little of the sacred stone’s power.

findings.current: The Black Tiger stared at me with deeply sunken eyes as I wondered about the legendary figure’s workout routine.
findings.defect: The draft changes Jin’s specific speculation about how the figure measured his big-three total into a general thought about his workout routine, while “deeply sunken eyes” incorrectly describes physical eye sockets rather than the subdued depth of the tiger’s gaze.
findings.rationale: 삼대 측정 방식 refers specifically to the method of measuring the three-lift total, and 깊숙이 가라앉은 modifies the mood of the gaze.
findings.replacement: The Black Tiger regarded me with a deep, somber gaze as I wondered how that legendary figure had measured his big-three total.
findings.source: 그리고 전설 속 인물의 삼대 측정 방식을 궁금해하는 나를, 흑호가 깊숙이 가라앉은 눈빛으로 응시했다.

findings.defect: The draft turns an unfinished demonstrative exclamation into an explicit question, resolving an intentional omission and slightly changing Yohi’s shocked reaction.
findings.rationale: 저건 is a stammered “that,” and the source trails off without asking what it is.

summary: One critical quantity error and four localized fidelity or ambiguity issues.
